## How do you know you understand?

Explain the inputs and units, solve an example independently, predict a changed condition, then verify with code or an experiment record. Reading a page, opening an answer or saving a bookmark is not a passed assessment.

[Assessment](assessment.md) · [Evidence boundaries](VALIDATION.md) · [Recorded benchmark](benchmark_report.md) · [Primary sources](SOURCES.md)

<p class="study-home-small">Teaching examples, simulation results and hardware validation are separate evidence levels. A lower level does not establish a higher one.</p>
